selected_evidence.summary: Kernel mount data shows all three flags on both mounts; execution and device-node probes were rejected.
Persistent fstab entries were present before and after reboot, and both recovered mounts retained the required flags.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 2fc81aed-3ce8-4a35-8f4c-b73206afa45f; reboot was acknowledged; post-reboot boot ID changed to 06257396-6e43-4e9b-89ff-e32af5f0e9f9; system health returned to running with both hardened mounts active.

commands.command:
set -eu
cp -a /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.pre-mount-hardening
awk '$2 != "/tmp" && $2 != "/dev/shm" { print }' /etc/fstab > /etc/fstab.mount-hardening.new
printf '%s\n' 'tmpfs /tmp tmpfs defaults,nodev,nosuid,noexec,mode=1777 0 0' 'tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs defaults,nodev,nosuid,noexec,mode=1777 0 0' >> /etc/fstab.mount-hardening.new
mv /etc/fstab.mount-hardening.new /etc/fstab
printf '%s\n' '-- persisted entries --'
awk '$2 == "/tmp" || $2 == "/dev/shm" { print }' /etc/fstab
findmnt --verify --verbose

commands.command:
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '-- persistent configuration --'
awk '$2 == "/tmp" || $2 == "/dev/shm" { print }' /etc/fstab
printf '%s\n' '-- kernel mount flags --'
findmnt -T /tmp -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,VFS-OPTIONS,FS-OPTIONS
findmnt -T /dev/shm -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,VFS-OPTIONS,FS-OPTIONS
for d in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  sudo cp /usr/bin/true "$d/.[REDACTED]"
  if "$d/.[REDACTED]"; then printf 'FAIL noexec %s: binary ran\n' "$d"; else printf 'PASS noexec %s: execution rejected rc=%s\n' "$d" "$?"; fi
  sudo mknod "$d/.antrieb-nodev-test" c 1 3
  if dd if="$d/.antrieb-nodev-test" of=/dev/null bs=1 count=1 2>/dev/null; then printf 'FAIL nodev %s: device was usable\n' "$d"; else printf 'PASS nodev %s: device access rejected rc=%s\n' "$d" "$?"; fi
  sudo rm -f "$d/.[REDACTED]" "$d/.antrieb-nodev-test"
done
printf '%s\n' '-- health --'
systemctl is-system-running
mountpoint /tmp
mountpoint /dev/shm
